en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship entering or moored in a harbor. Smoke rises from its funnel, and masts and rigging are visible. In the foreground, several people stand and walk along the waterfront, including men, women, and children near the water's edge. Simple shoreline structures and additional port buildings are visible in the background. Greek text appears at the bottom of the image, and a modern website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is superimposed over the lower-right portion.
